What it does

ServiceTitan is what trade businesses move to when they have multiple crews, a dedicated office team and enough volume that dispatch efficiency is worth real money. Its depth is genuine — dispatch, price book, marketing attribution and reporting all live in one place. The cost and the implementation effort are substantial, which is why it suits established operations rather than start-ups.

Where the AI actually is

AI features across dispatch, sales conversion and marketing attribution.

Pros

  • Very deep functionality
  • Strong reporting and business analytics
  • Scales to large operations

Cons

  • Expensive and heavy for small teams
  • Implementation takes real effort

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC in mind. Established businesses with multiple crews and a dedicated office team.

Alternatives
